remove_questions_from_dataset: run the script to remove questions from the ai2_arc test dataset and save to output directory
remove_questions_custom_dataset: run the script with a custom dataset name to remove questions from its test files
remove_questions_custom_output: run the script specifying a custom output directory for the question-free dataset
copy_non_test_splits: run the script to copy non-test splits like dev and val unchanged to the output directory
map_answer_options: run the script to map ABCD answer labels to option text while replacing questions with empty strings
